profile.headline: Staff Software Engineer - Surge Pricing
profile.summary: I'm a software engineer who focuses on improvements to quality & optimization systems (such as pricing and personalization) that drive direct revenue impact.

positions.title: Staff Software Engineer
positions.locationName: New York, New York, United States

positions.title: Staff Software Engineer
positions.description: I developed improvements to the YouTube Shorts ad auction & ad inventory systems. My launches were responsible for $100M/yr increase in Shorts ads revenue with zero offsetting impact to user engagement by shifting ad impressions to higher value placements.

positions.title: Staff Software Engineer
positions.description: I was a member of the marketplace team which was responsible for fulfillment by matching customer orders to shoppers. I launched an improvement to the dynamic pricing system to better utilize information about the time available until an order would be late. By increasing price variation along this dimension, I generated a large cost reduction at neutral impact to order lateness. The $30M/yr cost savings of this launch was the second largest single launch in the 80 person Marketplace org in H2'2021.

positions.title: Staff Software Engineer
positions.description:
Tech Lead and subsequently Tech Lead Manager for YouTube Search Ads team.

Tech Lead Manager of the YouTube Ads Inventory team from 3/2020. This team's role is to (1) introduce new ad formats and placements on YouTube to grow available ad placements and (2) to develop systems to control the quantity of ads in a user's YouTube session to optimize for long-term revenue. Key contributions in this role were

• Developing proposals to more effectively identify and control high ad quantity experiences on YouTube at a reduced revenue impact.
• Building the skill set of junior engineers to independently implement, experiment and evaluate changes to ad quality systems.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
In 7/2017, I proposed and initiated an experimental project to display text ads on YouTube search page. I subsequently served as tech lead as this grew into a larger team and business from zero to $300M/yr.

• Designed & implemented prototype to demonstrate product opportunity.
• Led cross-team project to productionize and launch text ads on YouTube search. Personal contributions include core infrastructure, ad relevance improvements, ad fill rate and depth optimization, ad UI exploration, and optimizations to reduce serving cost.
• Developed multi-year stategy roadmap of further product improvements and associated revenue opportunity in order to get approval to build a team focused on this product.

positions.title: Software Engineer III
positions.description:
From 8/2014 to 6/2017, I worked on personalization of Google search ads.

• Led several major launches to improve Google search ads pCTR model. Cumulatively, I am personally responsible for improvements resulting in +$300M/yr revenue.
• Extensive experience in development of user-based features and machine learning models for improving CTR predictions
• Improved infrastructure for rapid prototyping of personalization features.
• Lead or core team member on multiple projects to use new sources of user data for ad personalization

positions.title: Software Engineer II - Personalized Ads Quality
positions.description: Developed and implemented multiple techniques for automated generation of personalized search ads formats. Grew dynamic sitelinks ad format from $100M to $300M annual incremental revenue as one of two engineers on the team.

positions.title: Teaching Assistant
positions.description:
- Managed office hours and graded homework for a class of 80 students
- Rated 96% on teaching effectiveness by students

positions.title: Summer Research Fellow
positions.description:
- Reconstructed analysis from several neutrino oscillation experiments
- Utilized improved statistical methods to combine their results into one analysis
